name: std/terminal
description: Full-screen terminal programs: what a terminal sends and understands, the terminal as a device, and Oberon's model of a screen drawn into it -- tiled frames of text with a caret, and any line runnable as a command.
residual: Terminal is Unix only: raw mode is termios and the size is an ioctl. A Windows console twin is what a TUI there waits for, and until it exists this package builds on Unix targets alone; TerminalCodes and Frames are portable and carry no platform code.
Draft until a second program beside examples/Radio.Mod has been written on it: one program is not enough to say the shape of Frames is right.
